Class gameClient

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.controller.gameClient
public class gameClient extends Object
Represents the client-side network connection for multiplayer gameplay. This class is responsible for: Connecting to a game server via TCP socket Sending messages to the server (connect, answer, chat, disconnect) Listening for incoming messages from the server on a background thread Forwarding received messages to the UI thread via a callback All incoming messages are dispatched to the JavaFX Application Thread
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson

  • Method Details

    • setOnMessageReceived

      public void setOnMessageReceived(Consumer<String> callback)
      Sets the callback to be invoked when a message is received from the server. The callback is always called on the JavaFX Application Thread.
      Parameters:
      callback - the message handler to invoke with each received message

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, int port, String playerName) throws IOException
      Connects to the game server at the specified host and port. Sends an initial CONNECT message with the player's name, then starts a background listener thread that reads incoming messages and forwards them to the registered callback on the JavaFX thread.
      Parameters:
      host - the server hostname or IP address
      port - the server port number
      playerName - the name of the player connecting
      Throws:
      IOException - if the connection cannot be established

      answerIndex - the index (0-3) of the selected answer

    • sendChat

      public void sendChat(String playerName, String message)
